name: North Texas Mahjong
description: North Texas Mahjong (NTX Mahjong) runs American Mahjong open play and the NTX Mahjong Academy Foundations Workshop at TinMan Social (Little Elm) and Bella Mia Winery (Pilot Point). Organizer's workshop page: "covers American Mahjong essentials for newcomers ... card mechanics, NMJL card interpretation"; open play: "bring a 2026 NMJL Card".
schedule: Open play Mondays 6:00 PM at TinMan Social ($20); workshops Tue/Wed 6:00 PM ($45 at TinMan Social); open/guided play Wed 6:00 PM at Bella Mia Winery
